summary: The change spans the Bun-based llm_bridge provider API, the FastAPI same-origin proxy, and the Vue provider settings modal.
stack: Pytest, ruff, vue-tsc, vite, bun test
architecture: Provider catalog source of truth remains the bridge registry and per-provider model endpoint
The browser receives compact provider status first and fetches model catalogs on demand
The UI stores model lists in component-local memory for the modal lifetime
Packaged frontend assets are generated into appforge/resources/web
conventions: Keep bridge API responses JSON-only and same-origin proxied through FastAPI
Use script setup Vue components with typed props and emits
Keep tests behavior-focused at API and registry boundaries
test_strategy: Bun registry/server tests cover compact providers and removed all-models route
vue-tsc and Vite build cover frontend type and packaged asset integrity
Payload probe measures compact vs include_models response sizes using the local models.dev cache
risk_areas: Frontend code that assumes provider.models is always populated
Manual model input during lazy loading failures
OpenRouter-sized chip lists overwhelming the advanced settings row
Downstream clients depending on the removed /providers/models endpoint
baseline_status: The pre-existing dirty worktree already contained partial Phase4 edits before continuation
Initial quick checks after inspection passed: bun run typecheck, bun test, npm run typecheck
